name: Welcome!
objectiveText: Bring the Northshire Gift Voucher to Merissa Stilwell . Northshire Gift Voucher (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: You'll only see this if you have purchased the special edition of World of Warcraft.

As you might have guessed, this quest, along with all the other ones called "Welcome!" require you to have purchased the WoW Collector's Edition.  If you did, every time you start a new character, they will have the Gift Voucher in their inventory, and right-clicking it starts the quest.

When you turn the Voucher in, you can choose one of the three items that summons a special pet:  a panda cub, a zergling, or a mini diablo.
In classic, this quest will only be available to those who purchased the original WoW collectors edition and have it tied to their account.
